text:
alex: quick heads-up — clientlib vNext (vNext.0) rollout starts tomorrow 09:00 PT. there are 3 small breaking changes we should call out to integrators.

maria: can you list them here? I want to update the migration guide and the release notes. :memo:

alex: sure — brief:
1) auth: default token scope enforcement turned on (previously permissive). tokens must now include `inference:invoke` or calls will 403.
2) retries: default retry policy changed from 3 fixed retries to adaptive backoff with jitter and idempotency awareness. behavior differs for streaming vs unary.
3) streaming: server now sends `event: delta` frames and a final `event: done` envelope; clients that parsed raw chunks may need to adopt the event envelope parser.

sam: for auth, is the error code different or still 401/403?

alex: 403 for scope mismatch, 401 for expired/invalid token. migration note: check for 403 and guide users to add scope. example CLI check:

```
# check token scopes
redwoodctl auth:info --token $TOKEN
# should list: inference:invoke
```

kris: re: retries: does adaptive backoff change the retryable errors set? we have code that retries on 429/500 only.

alex: yes, we expanded to include 502/503/504 and throttling headers. also if request is non-idempotent (POST with side-effects flagged by `x-rw-non-idempotent` header) we won't retry by default. you can override with `client.retry.override=true` in config.

maria: streaming change — will existing Node/Python SDKs be backward compatible?

alex: Node SDK vNext will include a compatibility layer that can parse old raw chunks and the new envelope; Python vNext will require a small parser change but we provide a helper function `parse_stream_events(stream)`.

jen: pinging @sam for a quick test in the payments integration — we surface streaming deltas into the UI. if you can run canary tomorrow morning that'd be great.

sam: can do. what test vectors should I use?

alex: use short and long sequences to exercise partial-delta behavior. example prompt for deltas:

```
{"input":"Write a 6-step onboarding checklist for new users."}
```

and simulate a flaky network (250ms jitter) so we see reordering/fallbacks.

kris: any config flags teams should flip immediately to opt-in or opt-out?

alex: default on for everyone in hosted; private deployments get a toggle in the console: "Enable vNext defaults". for SDKs we added `client.options.compat_mode = 'legacy'` to opt-out of new retry+envelope parsing.

ci-bot: Reminder: create release notes PR and link the migration guide. Template: https://git.redwood.com/devex/release-templates/vnext.md

maria: I'll draft the migration guide now and put a checklist in the PR: auth scope snippet, retry override example, streaming helper snippet, and sample CANARY plan.

sam: I'll run the canary and share logs in this thread. will also grep for `403` and `event: done`.

jen: FYI - Docs will show a "Known breaking changes" callout and a short code diff for Node/Python/Go.

alex: thanks folks. last ask: if you see any unexpected 5xx during canary, don't roll forward and ping #eng-oncall. :rotating_light:

maria: on it. I'll also add a small migration test to the SDK CI that asserts `parse_stream_events` accepts old and new formats.

sam: starting canary at 09:05 PT. will post results. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

alex: awesome, appreciate it. once canary passes I'll trigger the staged rollout at 11:00 PT.
